title: The reduction of the step size after a failed post-Newton step in the common step size controller
author: Claude-JG
description: ODE23 and DOPRI5 reduced a step after a failed post-Newton step by a fixed factor of 0.5 and allowed the next step to grow, unlike the implicit solvers. Decided: one rule in StepSizeController for all solvers: a recommended step size, limited to 0.75 times the step, otherwise timeIntegration.adaptiveStepDecrease, without growth after the reduction.
releaseNotes: A step reduced after a failed post-Newton step follows one rule in all adaptive solvers, also with ODE23 and DOPRI5: no growth of the next step afterwards, and timeIntegration.adaptiveStepDecrease if no step size is recommended.
